# 3.3 Shiny versus FastAPI {.unnumbered}

## Story problem

**Separating computation from presentation**

- Your indicator computation becomes heavy.
- FastAPI serves computed results, Shiny renders UI and Folium map.
- You keep interactivity fast and reliable.

## What you will learn

- When a dashboard is enough and when you need an API.
- How to keep Folium-first dashboards lightweight by outsourcing heavy tasks.
- A minimal request-response mental model.
